# Version 4 ratings as they actually arrive, taken from the National
# Vulnerability Database. Public domain, as a work of the United States
# government.
#
# Two things about the shape. A real vector carries every metric the scheme
# has, with X where nothing was stated — version 3 vectors arrive with the
# base metrics alone, and version 4 vectors do not. And where the exploit
# maturity is stated, the number published beside the vector is not the base
# score: it is the base score with that metric applied, under a field the
# producer still calls the base score.
#
# Each line is the issue, the vector as published, and the number published
# beside it.
